name: Testament of Honor
description: The testament of honor is a divine warrior crafted to embody and enforce the principles of honorable, one-on-one combat. They are often employed as guardians at thresholds where any who enter must prove themselves worthy. They are armed with a sword where one edge is divine light and the other is cold steel.

actions.name: Broken Honor
actions.description: In response to any creature within 20 units that attacks the testament of honor that was not the first creature to attack it during this round, the testament of honor targets them in retaliation and deals divine damage.

actions.name: Celestial Blade
actions.description: The testament of honor makes an attack with a edge of their sword made of pure celestial light, dealing divine damage.

actions.name: Compel
actions.description: The testament of honor challenges a target that is adjacent to them. For the next minute, if that creature willfully moves away from the testament of honor, they take psychic damage. This effect ends prematurely if there are ever more than 4 units of distance between the target and testament of honor.

actions.name: Advance
actions.description: The testament of honor advances up to 3 units in a straight line towards another creature.

actions.name: Raise Shield
actions.description: The testament of honor gains a 1d4 bonus to the next block check it makes before the start of it's next turn. If an adjacent creature botches their attack roll against it, the testament of honor makes an attack with their Celestial Blade action.

actions.name: Hard Edge
actions.description: The testament of honor makes an attack with the metal edge of their sword, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target gains 1 tier of the wounded condition.

traits.name: Granted Magic
traits.description: The testament of honor is a divine creature and can channel divine spells without requiring components.
